description: This file defines the final class ManagedStorage which implements StorageInterface. It acts as a proxy/decorator for storage objects, deferring method calls to an underlying storage retrieved from a storage manager, with lazy initialization.

classes.name: ManagedStorage
classes.description: A final class that implements StorageInterface, acting as a lazy proxy to an underlying storage object managed by a StorageManager. It defers method calls to the actual storage, which is retrieved on first use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ManagedStorage with a StorageManagerInterface instance.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a storage item exists by delegating to the underlying storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a storage item by delegating to the underlying storage.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all storage items with optional prefix.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all storage items with optional prefix.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Gets the name of the current collection.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage object from the manager, initializing it if necessary.
